lines = content.splitlines()

for line in lines:
    t=line.strip()
    if not t:

    if t.startswith('#'):

    # skip indented bullet artifacts like ' - director:' (should already be caught)

    if 'director' in t and ':' in t:

    # stop if somehow 'The ' title was truncated? We'll keep as-is.

# Compose and send movie recommendations to Laura via text message

from datetime import datetime

# Login Simple Note
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); pass_map = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in creds}
sl = apis.simple_note.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password=pass_map['simple_note'])
sl_token = sl['access_token']

# Get movie recommendation note and extract titles
note_id = 1556
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=sl_token)
content = note['content']

lines = content.splitlines()
titles=[]
seen=set()
for line in lines:
    t=line.strip()
    if not t:
        continue
    if t.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if t.startswith('-'):
        continue
    if 'director' in t and ':' in t:
        continue
    if t not in seen:
        titles.append(t)
        seen.add(t)

message = ', '.join(titles)
print('message', message)

# Login phone
phone = apis.phone.login(username='8346699249', password=pass_map['phone'])
phone_token = phone['access_token']

# Find Laura contact
contacts=[]
i=0
while True:
    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Laura', page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not res:
        break
    contacts.extend(res)
    i+=1

laura = next((c for c in contacts if c.get('first_name','').lower()=='laura'), None)
print('laura', laura)

# Send text message
send_res = apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=laura['phone_number'], message=message, access_token=phone_token)
print('send_res', send_res)
